unresolved_question: Does the cross-sectional geometry of where stocks finish inside their completed daily ranges identify whether market-wide stress is being absorbed or amplified?

source.earliest_use: next trading decision after the completed source session

mechanism.absorption: A broad shock is absorbed when many stocks recover away from intraday lows despite negative close-to-close returns and when money is not concentrated in low-location closes.
mechanism.amplification: A shock is amplified when direction is synchronized, path efficiency is high, and a large share of stocks and money finish near the same adverse range extreme.
